limitations.note: The rewrite eliminated the broken reload detector but also asserted red during reset and removed the state-to-output pipeline, changing the startup and phase timing that the correct fix preserves.

The bench required the rewrite’s immediate-red reset and synchronized light and counter transitions, so its 3,350 passing checks could not catch the timing differences that caused the grading failure.

limitations.quote: The fix uses the registered one-hot light outputs to track the phase.
limitations.note: The agent repeated the rewrite described in the earlier entry even though the grading follow-up reported that it failed and warned that the original output pipeline’s timing mattered.
